P16-02.name: The BlackDeathDragon Bloodbone
P16-02.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Send a core each from every opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit to their Reserve. If [Soul Core] (Soul Core) is used to pay the summon cost, instead, send a core from the opposing Field to their Reserve.

[When Braved] [LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Nexus without any core on it.
